verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's own docs describe a self-hosted platform built to run entirely offline, including an air-gapped mode with complete network isolation. Running it that way with local models keeps user data from ever reaching a third-party model provider that could train on it. However, nothing explicitly addresses training use, and the docs also describe connecting to cloud providers, whose data handling the product does not govern. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training data policy or guarantee, controls over training use when cloud providers are connected, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: self-hosted AI platform that's extensible, feature-rich, user-friendly, and built to run entirely offline
Air-Gapped: Complete network isolation for environments with the strictest security requirements.
No AI key, no account with anyone, no cloud.
